apply: Per environment, with approval; nothing here has been applied.
1. Cut over first or keep the schedules from double-running: stop the Java worker, set core.scheduler.enabled=false on Java core, run core-scheduler and core-events (CORE_SCHEDULER.md).
2. If the app is missing there: POST <env>/api/security/applications {"appCode": "platform", "appName": "Platform", "appType": "APP", "appAccessType": "OWN"} (security is not transported).
3. POST <env>/api/core/transports/createAndApply?isForBaseApp=true&applicationCode=platform multipart file=@platform_SYSTEM.cmodl (as app-transport.sh applies a core chunk; 33 objects, one request).
4. Verify: GET <env>/api/core/eventDefinitions?appCode=platform&clientCode=SYSTEM lists the 11 jobs with their schedules; the first ticks show in the event run log.
